slice: KTM four-stroke owner's-manual suspension tables (450/350/250 SX-F, XC-F, 450 XCF-W) gap fill 2020-2026

records.statement: KTM's 2020 manual sets fork air at 10.7 bar (155 psi) on the EU 450 SX-F, 10.5 bar (152 psi) on the US SX-F and 10.1 bar (146 psi) on the XC-F; US bikes get a 45 N/mm shock spring for 75-85 kg riders (EU 42 N/mm), with 35 mm static / 105 mm riding sag.

values.standard_rider_weight: 75-85 kg (165-187 lb) in full riding gear
values.fork_position: 2nd milled groove from top flush with upper edge of upper triple clamp (no mm height given)

source.name: KTM Owner's Manual 2020 450 SX-F / 450 XC-F (art. no. 3214005en)

records.notes: No Factory Edition in this manual. US SX-F fork rebound is 6 clicks more open than EU and XC-F at every preset; XC-F shares the US HSC and spring table but the EU fork rebound table. Clicks/turns counted out from fully closed.

records.topic: owner's-manual suspension table: 2021 450 SX-F / 450 XC-F / Factory Edition
records.statement: KTM's 2021 manual sets the 450 SX-F air fork at 10.7 bar (155 psi) on EU and US bikes, 10.9 bar (158 psi) on the Factory Edition and 10.0 bar (145 psi) on the XC-F; US bikes use a 45 N/mm shock spring for 75-85 kg riders (EU 42 N/mm) with 35 mm static / 105 mm riding sag.

values.standard_rider_weight: 75-85 kg (165-187 lb) in full riding gear
values.fork_position: 2nd milled groove from top flush with upper edge of upper triple clamp (no mm height given)

source.name: KTM Owner's Manual 2021 450 SX-F / 450 XC-F / 450 SX-F Factory Edition (art. no. 3214217en)

records.notes: The earlier 2021 manual without the Factory Edition (art. no. 3214216en, 05/2020, https://www.ktmshop.se/bike-manuals/21_3214216_en_OM.pdf) gives identical values for SX-F EU/US and XC-F. EU springs are one step (3 N/mm) softer per weight band than US/XC-F/FE.

records.topic: owner's-manual suspension table: 2023 450 SX-F / 450 XC-F / Factory Edition
records.statement: KTM's 2023 manual sets fork air at 10.4 bar (151 psi) on the EU 450 SX-F, 10.7 bar (155 psi) on the US SX-F, 10.9 bar (158 psi) on the Factory Edition and 10.1 bar (146 psi) on the XC-F; all versions use 42/45/48 N/mm shock springs for 65-75/75-85/85-95 kg riders with 35 mm static / 105 mm riding sag.

values.standard_rider_weight: 75-85 kg (165-187 lb) in full riding gear
values.fork_position: 2nd milled groove from top flush with upper edge of upper triple clamp (no mm height given)

source.name: KTM Owner's Manual 2023 450 SX-F / 450 XC-F / 450 SX-F Factory Edition (art. no. 3214642en)

records.notes: From 2023 the EU and US share one shock spring table, HSC table and preload; only fork air and fork rebound differ by version. Fork tech data (sections 22.7/22.8) was beyond the readable part of the PDF.

records.topic: owner's-manual suspension table: 2024 450 SX-F / 450 XC-F / Factory Edition
records.statement: KTM's 2024 manual sets the 450 SX-F air fork at 10.4 bar (151 psi) on EU/BR bikes, 10.7 bar (155 psi) on US bikes and 10.5 bar (152 psi) on the Factory Edition; the XC-F has a coil fork, and all versions use 42/45/48 N/mm shock springs for 65-75/75-85/85-95 kg riders with 35 mm static / 105 mm riding sag.

values.XC-F_fork: coil-spring fork (no air value); spring rate not in the readable manual text
values.standard_rider_weight: 75-85 kg (165-187 lb) in full riding gear
values.fork_position: 2nd milled groove from top flush with upper edge of upper triple clamp (no mm height given)

source.name: KTM Owner's Manual 2024 450 SX-F / 450 XC-F / 450 SX-F Factory Edition (art. no. 3214836en)

records.notes: New-generation (2023+) chassis. XC-F fork spring rate sits in technical data, past the point where the PDF text extraction stopped. Factory Edition: connectivity-unit strap 19 mm from the upper triple clamp.

records.statement: KTM's 2020 manual sets fork air at 10.4 bar (151 psi) on the EU 250 SX-F, 10.3 bar (149 psi) on the US SX-F and 9.8 bar (142 psi) on the XC-F, with 39/42/45 N/mm shock springs for 65-75/75-85/85-95 kg riders and 35 mm static / 105 mm riding sag.

values.standard_rider_weight: 75-85 kg (165-187 lb) in full riding gear
values.fork_position: 2nd milled groove from top flush with upper edge of upper triple clamp (no mm height given)

source.name: KTM Owner's Manual 2020 250 SX-F / 250 XC-F (art. no. 3214003en)

records.notes: Shock preload differs on all three versions (8 / 9 / 6 mm). Only the US SX-F uses the 23/18/13 fork rebound table this year.

records.statement: KTM's 2021 and 2022 manuals set fork air at 10.4 bar (151 psi) on the EU 250 SX-F, 10.5 bar (152 psi) on the US SX-F and 9.8 bar (142 psi) on the XC-F, with 39/42/45 N/mm shock springs for 65-75/75-85/85-95 kg riders and 35 mm static / 105 mm riding sag.

values.standard_rider_weight: 75-85 kg (165-187 lb) in full riding gear
values.fork_position: 2nd milled groove from top flush with upper edge of upper triple clamp (no mm height given)

records.notes: The 2021 manual (250 SX-F / 250 XC-F / 250 SX-F Troy Lee Designs, art. no. 3214213en, 07/2020, https://www.ktmshop.se/documents/21_3214213_en_OM.pdf) gives the identical table; the TLD edition uses the EU values. Compared with 2020: US SX-F air 10.5 vs 10.3 bar, XC-F now uses the 23/18/13 fork rebound table, XC-F preload 7 vs 6 mm.

records.statement: KTM's 2026 manual sets the 250 SX-F air fork at 10.3 bar (149 psi) on EU, BR and US bikes; the XC-F has a coil fork, and all versions use 39/42/45 N/mm shock springs for 65-75/75-85/85-95 kg riders with 35 mm static / 105 mm riding sag and 8 mm preload.

values.standard_rider_weight: 75-85 kg (165-187 lb) in full riding gear
values.fork_position: 2nd milled groove from top flush with upper edge of upper triple clamp (no mm height given)

source.name: KTM Owner's manual 2026 250 SX-F / 250 XC-F (item no. 3240234en)

records.notes: Only the fork rebound table differs between versions. The fork-adjuster text says 'clockwise' for both the stop and the counting direction (likely a wording error; counts are from fully closed). Fork/shock tech data (22.4/22.5) beyond the readable text; a cloudfront copy of the same file also lists a 250 SX-F Factory Edition in the title.

records.statement: KTM's 2021 manual sets fork air at 10.4 bar (151 psi) on the EU 350 SX-F, 10.6 bar (154 psi) on the US SX-F and 9.8 bar (142 psi) on the XC-F (including the Kailub Russell edition), with 39/42/45 N/mm shock springs for 65-75/75-85/85-95 kg riders and 35 mm static / 105 mm riding sag.

values.standard_rider_weight: 75-85 kg (165-187 lb) in full riding gear
values.fork_position: 2nd milled groove from top flush with upper edge of upper triple clamp (no mm height given)

source.name: KTM Owner's Manual 2021 350 SX-F / 350 XC-F / 350 XC-F Kailub Russell (art. no. 3214215en)

records.notes: Hosted on enduro.team (a copy of the official KTM PDF); ktmshop.se copy not indexed. Kailub Russell edition adds a Factory Start (holeshot) device on the fork. Table is identical to the 2022 manual (km8-006) and matches the 2020 one except US SX-F air (10.6 vs 10.4 bar).

records.statement: KTM's 2023 manual sets fork air at 10.3 bar (149 psi) on EU/AR 350 SX-Fs, 10.6 bar (154 psi) on US SX-Fs and 9.9 bar (144 psi) on the XC-F, with 42/45/48 N/mm shock springs for 65-75/75-85/85-95 kg riders and 35 mm static / 105 mm riding sag.

records.notes: New-generation chassis: shock springs one step stiffer than 2020-2022 (42/45/48 vs 39/42/45 N/mm) and one HSC/preload value for all versions.

records.statement: KTM's 2025 manual sets the 350 SX-F air fork at 10.4 bar (151 psi) on EU, AR and US bikes; the XC-F has a coil fork, and all versions use 42/45/48 N/mm shock springs for 65-75/75-85/85-95 kg riders with 35 mm static / 105 mm riding sag.

values.XC-F_fork: coil-spring fork (no air value); spring rate not in the readable manual text

values.fork_position: 2nd milled groove from top flush with upper edge of upper triple clamp (no mm height given)

source.name: KTM Owner's Manual 2025 350 SX-F / 350 XC-F (art. no. 3240044en)

records.notes: Manual says differences up to about 10 kg from the standard rider weight can be handled with preload or fork air; larger differences need other springs. XC-F fork spring rate is in technical data past the readable part of the PDF.

records.statement: KTM's 2023 manual for the 450 XCF-W (shared with the 450/500 EXC-F) lists a progressive linkless (PDS) shock spring of 60-66 N/mm for 65-75 kg riders, 63-69 N/mm for 75-85 kg and 66-72 N/mm for 85-95 kg, with 37 mm static / 110 mm riding sag and 18/15/12-click fork and shock presets.

values.standard_rider_weight: 75-85 kg (165-187 lb) in full riding gear
values.fork_type: coil-spring fork, compression adjuster (white, COMP) on left leg and rebound (red, REB) on right leg; model name not in readable text

source.name: KTM Owner's Manual 2023 450 EXC-F / 450 EXC-F Six Days / 450 XCF-W / 500 EXC-F (art. no. 3214649en)

records.notes: One table for all models in the manual; nothing XCF-W-specific. Fork spring rate, fork oil and fork height are in technical data (23.7/23.8), past the readable part of the PDF. Spring ranges are progressive PDS springs. Fork T-grip preload adjusters are a Six Days item on earlier EXC models; the extraction did not say whether the XCF-W has them.

records.statement: KTM's 2025 and 2026 manuals for the 450 XCF-W (shared with the 450/500 EXC-F) list linear shock springs of 69 N/mm for 65-75 kg riders, 72 N/mm for 75-85 kg and 75 N/mm for 85-95 kg, with 38 mm static / 110 mm riding sag and 7 mm preload.

values.standard_rider_weight: 75-85 kg (165-187 lb) in full riding gear
values.fork_spring_rate: not in the readable manual text (technical data section)

source.name: KTM Owner's manual 2026 450 EXC-F / 450 EXC-F Six Days / 450 XCF-W / 500 EXC-F (item no. 3240243en)

records.notes: The 2025 manual (item no. 3240051en, 11/2024, https://www.ktmshop.se/bike-manuals/25_3240051_en_BA.pdf, also covering 500 XW-F and Champion Editions) gives the identical table. Single linear shock spring numbers replace the progressive ranges of 2023 (new-generation chassis). Fork presets 17/15/7 compression and 19/17/9 rebound are as read from both manuals; the uneven step is unusual, so verify on the bike. Fork-adjuster text says 'clockwise' for both stop and count direction (likely a wording error). Fork spring rate in technical data beyond the readable text.

not_found: KTM 450 SX-F / 450 XC-F 2022 (art. no. 3214418en, Factory Edition 3214419en): found only on partsfinder.clpstudio.ro, which redirects to a cloudfront URL the fetch tool refused (provenance); device.report copy errored; guessed ktmshop.se URL 22_3214418_en_OM.pdf needed a permission that was not granted; manualzz/manua.ls show only the table of contents.
KTM 450 SX-F / 450 XC-F 2026 and 350 SX-F 2026 owner's manuals: not indexed by search (searched 'Owner's manual 2026 450 SX-F', item-number guesses 3240236, BA.pdf).

KTM 450 XCF-W 2024 (art. no. 3214841en): no ktmshop.se copy indexed; manualslib and manua.ls pages return only the cover/table of contents (page parameters ignored). 2024 SETUP INSTRUCTIONS (24_3214917_en_SUI) exists but setup instructions carry no suspension values (checked the 2021 350 SUI).
Coil fork spring rates (2024+ 250/350/450 XC-F closed-cartridge coil fork; 450 XCF-W 2023-2026): in each manual's technical-data chapter, which is past where the fetch tool's PDF text stops.
Fork height in mm: KTM manuals give only '2nd milled groove flush with the upper triple clamp' for SX-F/XC-F.
